solution.title: Android Enterprise Connection & Managed Google Play Setup in Intune

products.name: Android Enterprise Connection & Managed Google Play Setup in Intune — Commercial
products.short_description: Connect Intune to managed Google Play and stand up the Android Enterprise enrollment profiles (work profile, fully managed, corporate-owned work profile, dedicated/COSU) with enrollment restrictions — the foundation the rest of Android management builds on. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Stand up Android Enterprise in Intune — the right binding and enrollment profiles

Android management in Intune starts with one thing done correctly: the managed Google Play binding and the enrollment model. Get it wrong and nothing enrolls. This solution connects Intune to managed Google Play (the account-enterprise model for tenants without Google Workspace), then stands up the enrollment profiles — personally-owned work profile (BYOD), fully managed, corporate-owned work profile, and dedicated/COSU — with the enrollment restrictions, so the right devices enroll the right way.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the managed Google Play binding, the four Android Enterprise enrollment models and when to use each, and the Assess→Configure→Pilot→Validate→Expand model.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Intune + Android Enterprise licensing, admin roles, the binding-model decision, network endpoints).
  • Implementation Guide — connect managed Google Play, configure enrollment restrictions + platform settings, create the enrollment profiles for each model, and validate a pilot enrollment — pilot-first, each profile named.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Microsoft Graph / Intune automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (binding healthy, each enrollment model works, restrictions enforced) plus Best Practices for a clean Android Enterprise foundation.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A correct Android Enterprise foundation in Intune — managed Google Play bound, enrollment models configured, restrictions enforced — so devices enroll the right way and everything else works.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • ANDROIDENT-Discovery.ps1 — assess the managed Google Play connection + Android enrollment config (read-only)
    • ANDROIDENT-New-EnrollmentProfile.ps1 — create a corporate-owned Android Enterprise enrollment profile (default -WhatIf)
    • ANDROIDENT-Report.ps1 — Android Enterprise readiness + per-model enrollment coverage (read-only)
    • ANDROIDENT-Set-EnrollmentRestrictions.ps1 — set the Android enrollment platform restriction (default -WhatIf)
    • ANDROIDENT-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build the pilot/prod + per-model scope groups (default -WhatIf)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
